gv.merchant_member_id = #{snapshot.beneficiaryId} and gv.activity_id = #{snapshot.scopeId}) as groupVerifyTime, (select min(gm.verify_time) from coop_group_member_verify gm where gm.registration_id = r.id and gm.activity_id = #{snapshot.scopeId}) as groupMemberVerifyTime, r.verification_time as verificationTime from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{snapshot.commercialContextId} for update
